question: What is the attendance requirement to sit in the Major exam?
gold_answer: Under the July 2024 amendment, examination performance/eligibility is no longer linked to attendance (the old rule requiring a C grade for students below 75% was superseded). Students are expected to have full attendance and attendance must not fall below 75% in a course; below 75% without valid reason the instructor can recommend de-registration.

question: How many Open Elective credits do I need to earn in order to get a B.Tech. Degree?
gold_answer: 10 Open Elective (OE) credits for a regular B.Tech. (0 for B.Tech. with specialization or dual degree).

question: I missed my Major exam because I was ill. How do I apply for a make-up exam?
gold_answer: Apply to the Dean (Academics) through the course instructor within ten days from the date of the missed examination, explaining the reasons (with a medical certificate for illness). If permitted, the make-up for the major is held slot-wise during the make-up/supplementary week as per the academic calendar of the subsequent semester.

question: When are the Major examinations for Semester I of 2026-27?
gold_answer: 19-26 November 2026.

question: How long is the Major examination and what is its minimum weightage?
gold_answer: 3 hours, with a weightage of not less than 40% of the overall evaluation (July 2024 examination-policy circular, which supersedes the older 120-minute rule).

question: What happens if I am absent from all academic activities for four weeks in a semester?
gold_answer: Absence from all academic activities for four or more weeks (not necessarily contiguous) in a semester, with or without sanctioned leave, results in automatic semester withdrawal from all courses.

question: What is the last date to add or drop courses in Semester I 2026-27?
gold_answer: 7 August 2026 (Friday).

question: To whom should a B.Tech. student address an application for leave of absence?
gold_answer: To the Convener, DUGC, submitted with a medical certificate if applicable; leave should normally not be availed without prior approval.

question: How many total credits are required for a regular B.Tech. degree?
gold_answer: 165 credits in total: 150 graded credits plus 15 non-graded credits (6 NH, 3 NE, 6 ND).

question: How many credits must a B.Tech. student earn by the end of the second semester to continue in the programme?
gold_answer: At least 18 credits for GEN/OBC/GEN-EWS students and 14 for SC/ST/PD students; otherwise the student may restart the programme (once) or registration is terminated.

question: When is the Minor examination in Semester I 2026-27?
gold_answer: 15-20 September 2026.

question: What is the maximum duration allowed to complete a B.Tech. programme?
gold_answer: 14 registered semesters.
